# Steam Store

> Steam is Valve's digital distribution platform and gaming ecosystem offering games, hardware, community features, and virtual currency services.

Steam serves as the primary storefront for PC gaming with integrated social features, game discovery tools, and hardware products like the Steam Deck. The platform provides account management, personalized recommendations, and seasonal sales alongside community-driven content and marketplace features.

## Key Topics

- Steam Platform
- Digital Distribution
- Game Store
- Steam Deck
- Authentication
- Steam Community
- Steam Points Shop
- Game Discovery
- News Hub
- Steam Charts
- Wishlists
- DLC Management
- Seasonal Sales
- Community Recommendations
- Account Management

## Core Platform & Store

- [Welcome to Steam](https://store.steampowered.com): Steam platform homepage with store navigation and account login
- [Steam, The Ultimate Online Game Platform](https://store.steampowered.com/about): Platform overview describing Steam features and services
- [Sign In](https://store.steampowered.com/explore): Steam authentication and sign-in page for account access
- [Steam Points Shop](https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop): Steam Points Shop for virtual currency cosmetics and rewards
- [Spring Sale Featured Deep Discounts](https://store.steampowered.com/sale/special_deals): Steam seasonal sale with featured deep discount deals

## Game Discovery & Recommendations

- [Wishlist - Error](https://store.steampowered.com/wishlist): Steam Wishlists for tracking and discovering games
- [Sign In](https://store.steampowered.com/recommender): Game recommendation engine requiring Steam authentication
- [DLC For Your Games](https://store.steampowered.com/dlcforyou): Personalized DLC recommendations for owned games
- [Community Recommendations](https://store.steampowered.com/communityrecommendations): User-generated game recommendations from Steam Community
- [Crimson Desert on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3321460/Crimson_Desert): Crimson Desert game store page on Steam platform

## Hardware & Statistics

- [Steam Deck™](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675200/Steam_Deck): Steam Deck handheld gaming device product page
- [Steam Charts](https://store.steampowered.com/stats): Steam Charts displaying game statistics and player rankings
- [Steam Charts](https://store.steampowered.com/charts/steamdecktopplayed): Steam Deck top played games charts and statistics
- [Steam, The Ultimate Online Game Platform](https://store.steampowered.com/mobile): Steam Mobile App information and download page

## News & Community

- [Featured News - Steam News Hub](https://store.steampowered.com/news): Steam News Hub aggregating featured gaming news and updates
- [Featured News - Steam News Hub](https://store.steampowered.com/newshub): Steam News Hub featuring gaming news and platform updates

- [Steam Refunds](https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds): Steam refund policy and purchase protection guide
